sc: Argonite ore is an ore that can only be obtained while Dungeoneering.
It can either be bought from the Smuggler, received as a monster drop or mined from an Argonite rock, requiring level 60 Mining.
The Ariane pack is a pack inspired by Ariane that may be purchased from Solomon's General Store.

It is made by custom-fitting augmented masterwork ranged chaps at the Master Crafter in the clothesmaking section of the Crafting Guild, or by augmenting custom-fit masterwork ranged chaps with an augmentor and 36 divine charges at an invention workbench.
It is made by combining an augmentor and a Guildmaster Tony's mattock.
There is also a 1/10 chance of yielding an additional material on a successful action as indicated by a chat message: When this happens, experience is awarded for both excavated materials.
The shadow-dyed augmented noxious scythe is a level 90 Melee two-handed weapon, created by using an augmentor on a shadow-dyed noxious scythe, or by using shadow dye on an augmented noxious scythe.

The barrows-dyed augmented off-hand blightbound crossbow is a level 92 Ranged off-hand weapon, created by using an augmentor on a Off-hand blightbound crossbow (Barrows), or by using Barrows dye on an augmented off-hand blightbound crossbow.

sc: Beer glasses are obtained by drinking certain beverages (such as beer), from the shelves in the Sorceress's house, or found as item spawns in the game (see Item sources below).
They can also be made with molten glass using the Crafting skill.
It is made by using the bear ribs with a pot of vinegar.
It is made by enchanting a sapphire bracelet with the Lvl-1 Enchant spell.
The effect given by freeing the Star Sprite comes in handy here as well, as players have a chance of mining 3 soft clay at a time, while only using one charge from the bracelet.

sc: The Brimhaven tablet is a modified Teleport to house tablet that is created by using a chisel on a normal Teleport to house tablet.
Broodoo Wand is a main hand magic weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 375 H'oddments from the H'oddments Store.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 6 of Count Yakula's Yak Track with the premier pass.
Cadantine seeds can be obtained as a monster drop, by pickpocketing Master Farmers or bought from the Vinesweeper minigame for 1,000 points each.

Clue scroll (hard) - Aggie I see.x: Clue scroll (hard) is a cryptic clue obtained from hard sealed clue scrolls. It contains a clue to solve Treasure Trails.

sc: Clue scroll (master) is an anagram clue obtained from master sealed clue scrolls.
Three are found on the monkey island after using the de-lore-ing device, but they have no use.

Colonist Top.x: The Colonist Top is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Colonist outfit. It is the override equivalent of the Colonist's coat and Colonist's dress top items.

sc: It can be obtained for free from the Competitive Group Ironman armour stand on the Iron Enclave by players who formed a competitive group in the Group Ironman Mode.

sc: The Crown of the First Necromancer is a piece of tier 95 Necromancy power armour, obtained as a rare drop from Rasial, the First Necromancer.
The dark helm is a rare prize from Treasure Hunter and is part of the Dark outfit.

u: Augmented Dark Shard of Leng (Third Age)
sc: It can be created by using a Third Age dye on the Dark Shard of Leng.
It could be purchased from Thordur for 10 coins.
After the 2021 server login issues was resolved, a cosmetic item with the same name was given as compensation along with many other items contained in returner's gift box.

sc: On the battlefield, divine tears can be obtained from Divine Tears Formations (Woodcutting), Divine Tear Rocks (Mining), Divine Tear pools (Fishing) or by killing warriors from the opposite faction.

Throughout the rest of Gielinor, they are obtained by killing any creature that drops summoning charms or by Farming, Fishing, Herblore, Hunter, Mining, Runecrafting, or Woodcutting, including actions at Clan Citadel skill plots.
A Dormant anima core helm can be obtained as a drop in the Heart of Gielinor.
No additional experience is awarded for any anima stones consumed in the process.
Elemental anima stones may be obtained from pickpocketing Crux Eqal Knights and druids, as well as from Zemouregal's undead creatures.
The Equilibrium iron trophy is a reward from Equilibrium League.
It is earned at 4,000 League points and is awarded to the nominated account at the end of the league.
It is given by the Customs Sergeant in Rimmington, and should be filled with the 5 pirates' marks to create the file (marks).
The full file can then be obtained at the prison by talking to the Locker Officer upstairs and asking for the file with your own name on it.
A yellow Fishing tome is an experience reward from the minigame, Temple Trekking.
Grey gloves can be purchased from Barker at his store Barker's Haberdashery in Canifis.
This tablet can be made on a mahogany eagle lectern in a player-owned house, using 1 soft clay, 2 law runes, and 2 fire runes.
Grimy wormwood leaf is the lowest tier 2 grimy herb found while training Dungeoneering in Daemonheim's dungeons.
It can be obtained as either a monster drop or from planting a wormwood seed, which requires at least level 40 Farming.

Imperial steel is an Archaeological material that can be obtained through excavating material caches or various excavation sites, requiring level 12 Archaeology, at various dig sites around RuneScape.
It can also be found in a bookcase in a player-owned house and in Nulodion's Multicannon Shop at the north-west part of the Dwarven mines on Ice Mountain.
This piece of armour cannot be made using Crafting.
Before a higher tier can be bought, previous tiers must also be bought.
Longbow of Diamonds is a two-handed ranged weapon cosmetic override that could be unlocked by purchasing the King and Queen of Diamonds Pack.
A lemon was obtained at the crate of luxurious lemons near the Apprentice.
The mechanical spider leg 4 is found in the darker dimension during the 2016 Halloween event.
All 8 legs and 500 reward points can be exchanged for the Dr Spider MD pet.

Medium dusk lantern.x: Medium dusk lanterns can be obtained as part of the Celestial Lanterns promotion on Treasure Hunter. They gives both direct experience and bonus experience in a skill of choice when released, destroying the lantern.

sc: It was made by upgrading a strong slayer helmet for 600 Slayer points at any Slayer Master, although subsequent upgrades would only cost 60 Slayer points.
Most Wanted card (glacors) is a possible reward from the Rush of Blood Distraction and Diversion.
The card increases the chances of obtaining a unique drop from glacors.
When a pair of Glacyte boots is obtained with the help of the card, 50 charges will be used up at once.
The mystery cracker is an item received by a player who has been referred to RuneScape by a friend.

Mystery firework.x: The mystery firework is an item added to the game on 17 December 2018, which is part of the Firework Festival promotion. It has a chance to act like any other firework or give up to an x8 multiplier.

sc: An oak dresser flatpack can be made at a workbench (Oak workbench or better) in the workshop of a player-owned house.
The Ocean's Mage Head is a head slot cosmetic override that could be unlocked by progressing through the RunePass.
To obtain this item, players must partake in smithing a ceremonial sword after randomly being given plans when they finish smithing an item in the Artisans' Workshop.
Although only members can smith this sword and it is untradeable, the wield option and the stats are available in free-to-play.
It can be obtained by giving Roberta a total of 100 porcelain clay, using any combination of noted or unnoted standard and soft forms.
The Onyx Gala Attire Gloves are a hands slot cosmetic override that is part of the Onyx Gala Attire outfit, obtained by redeeming a Onyx Gala Attire token.
The orange shield key is a key found in Daemonheim while training the Dungeoneering skill.
Only one orange shield key can be found in a single dungeon.
A penguin head is part of the Penguin outfit, and is obtained by completing the fourth quest episode of the 2015 Christmas event.

Pharaoh's nemes (blue).x: The brown pharaoh's nemes is part of the pharaoh's outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: Other than trading, f2p players can obtain them from the sawmill or plank maker in Rimmington, or spawns in the Wilderness.
With the current Grand Exchange price, each experience point received by building wooden furniture would cost .
Platinum Pernix Armour is a cosmetic override set that can be unlocked by redeeming a Platinum Pernix Armour token.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 primal bars, requiring 2,200 progress to complete, granting a total of 2,800 Smithing experience.
Raven's Kiss shuriken off-hand is an off-hand ranged weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 750 H'oddments from the H'oddments Store.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 36 of Count Yakula's Yak Track with the premier pass.
Redcane medley is obtained by using redcane with a cabbage, onion, or raw potato.
It can be found on the enemy pirate ship, allowing players to return to The Adventurous.
Due to an oversight, it was previously possible to obtain the item via Telekinetic Grab, and drop it elsewhere for an infinite source of rope.
This mask was also obtainable during the 2025 and 2026 Halloween events by smashing the Smashing Pumpkin in the Graveyard.
A rummage ticket was obtainable from Balthazar during the September 2015 Balthazar's Big Raffle, for every 5 raffle tickets handed in.
A total of 12 rummage tickets could be obtained by the end of September.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 rune bars, requiring 1,200 progress to complete, granting a total of 480 Smithing experience.
The yellow runecrafter hat can be bought at the Runecrafting Guild for 1,000 Runecrafting guild tokens.

RuneScape Road Trip journal (2014).x: The RuneScape Road Trip journal is an item given by Challenge Mistress Fara during the RuneScape Road Trip event that was active throughout May 2014. There were 20 different tasks on the Journal that lasted for the month, and completing those allowed players to gain rewards from the 'Rewards' tab.

sc: Scorpion meat is a common food reward from the Dominion Tower.
While the number of meat obtained is dependent on the number of Dominion Factor players have, they can get this meat regardless of the Factor count.
The Seer's headband 2 is an item and a reward from the easy and medium Seers' Village achievements.
It is received from Stankers at the coal truck mining site.

h: 75% discount: 76 RuneCoins for members, 85 for free-to-play
sc: Shadow Ariane is a cosmetic override outfit that can be purchased for 1,500 H'oddments from the H'oddments Store.
It could previously be purchased from Solomon's General Store at the price of 340 RuneCoins for free users and 306 RuneCoins for members.
The ship's wheel shield is an item that can be redeemed with 1,500 doubloons during the Talk like a Pirate promotion from Treasure Hunter.
The ship's wheel shield can also be obtained from the event mystery box or big event mystery box during the Deathbeard's Demise event.
Silver medals were made by using two silver nuggets on the forge at Gielinor Games preparation.
A silvthril chain is a component of the Ivandis flail and is created by the player during or after the Legacy of Seergaze quest.

Skill firework.x: The skill firework is an item added to the game on 17 December 2018, which is part of the Firework Festival promotion. Lighting it gives a prize that can normally be won in Treasure Hunter as a prize for the the skill shown below the firework, or, in the case of the prismatic category, as a prismatic prize (i.e. lamps or stars to be used on any skill).

sc: Slayer Trophy (Skeleton) is an item given as a reward by the Raptor for completing his unique Slayer challenge with at least level 50 Slayer for the second time.
It is the second trophy in a set of three awarded in sequence, preceded by a zombie and followed by a phantom version.

sc: Springtime Dungaree Top (Pastel) is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked through the Egg Hunt promotion from Treasure Hunter.
The stalker gland is an item that could be obtained from 8 January until 22 January 2018 from the Guardian of the Premier Vault, by players who purchased the 2018 Premier Club Gold package.
The gland can be exchanged with Kuradal, Morvran or Laniakea to ensure stalker creatures as the player's next Slayer assignment.
Players who have not completed Dishonour among Thieves could obtain this item, but will not be able to get the task until the quest is completed.
The outfit has also been available in the Yak Coin Shop for 6 Yak coins.
They can be made at a forge and anvil using 1 steel bar, requiring 300 progress to complete, granting a total of 75 Smithing experience.
Steel gauntlets were originally obtained as a reward from the Fist of Guthix minigame.
The strange device is an item obtained during the Ritual of the Mahjarrat quest.
Strawberry cream cheese is a version of cream cheese made with strawberry milk.
It is made on a player-owned port Scrimshaw Crafter with 2 ancient bones, provided the energy-gathering scrimshaw scroll has been purchased from Boni on Waiko (for 5,000 chimes and 5 taijitu).
When activated, it gives the player a 20% chance to double the divine energy received when gathering memories (this applies even if a memory is not obtained).
It can be obtained by talking to Fairy Nuff in the Queen's chamber in Zanaris.

Tempest Lord Chestplate.x: The Tempest Lord Chestplate is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Tempest Lord Armour set. It is unlocked alongside its static variant.

sc: The Account of Aesa Fellsdottir (Part 1), also known as Mad Ramblings (1) in the Barbarian Assault rewards shop, is an item that can be purchased from Commander Connad for 25 Honour Points in any role.
The Beast of Darkness is a lore book dropped by Kezalam, the Wanderer.
Thigat longbow (unstrung) is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It is made by using a knife on Thigat branches.

sc: It can be activated to obtain an anti-dragon throwing disc case, destroying the token in the process.
The outfit has also been available in the Yak Coin Shop for 6 Yak coins.
They can be bought for 3,500 teci from Raid Rewards or dropped from beastmaster's hounds and airuts.
Originally this armour was available from the Tuska Comes world event, and it cost 3,500 Reward Currency.
A wooden knot is an item obtained from cutting normal trees with a Dwarven army axe.
It may be crafted with the Dwarven army axe or a chisel into an unfinished wooden brooch, granting 20 crafting experience.
Wyvern bones are dropped by wyverns and skeletal wyverns, very dangerous monsters found in the Asgarnian Ice Caves.
Players can quite rarely receive Wyvern bones as a reward from the Soul Wars minigame by selecting the Gamble option.
A XP lamp (tier 3) is an item obtained during the Broken Home quest.
It is the third lamp obtained in the quest, located in a chest found in the basement, in the room south-west of the Servant's Quarters.
It cannot be obtained on the first playthrough, and requires at least level 30 in each skill except for the skills released after Divination: Invention, Archaeology, and Necromancy.
